cells.gaps: No source found says a law, decree, regulation or circular makes the standards compulsory: the 2023 Public Service Regulations task each department's GITO with interoperability, not with these standards. The update of the standards was being written in 2026 (ZAF-001) and is not held as issued.
cells.note: The DPSA published the Minimum Interoperability Standards for departments' systems (ZAF-002, 2025), and the 2026 work is an update of them (ZAF-001), so the published edition stands. Stage 4 needs a text making them compulsory, and none is held.
